entities.summary: Einar Laurentius "Linkan" Lindqvist was a Swedish ice hockey and bandy player. He competed in the 1920 Summer Olympics. He died in Uppsala, Sweden. In 1920 he was a member of the Swedish ice hockey team which finished fourth in the Summer Olympics tournament. He played all six matches and scored three goals.
